{{Quote|Eat lightsaber, jerk!|Kira Carsen|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kira Carsen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Born in [[3663 BBY]] on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] parents, Carsen underwent [[Sith training]] as a child, but she fled the Empire after discovering she had been turned into a [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]]&mdash;an unwilling puppet of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Carsen survived on her own through her teenage years on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], but when she met the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]], she was recruited into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as Kiwiiks' [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], though Carsen told no one of her true origins.

In [[3643 BBY]], Carsen became involved in a [[Desolator crisis|crisis]] involving stolen Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] and the agents of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], and was reassigned as the Padawan of a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] who was the former student of Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]]. Carsen and her new teacher proved integral in stopping Darth Angral's crusade of vengeance against the Republic, chasing the Sith's agents across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], but in doing so she came to the attention of the Sith Emperor, and her past was exposed to the Jedi Order when [[Valis|the Emperor's agent]] tried to capture her.

Though some Jedi believed her to be untrustworthy, Carsen purged the Emperor's influence in the [[Battle of the Oppressor|final battle]] with Angral, earning herself the rank of Jedi Knight. Carsen continued to serve alongside her former teacher, now known as the Hero of Tython, as the galaxy erupted into [[Galactic War|renewed war]], and worked as part of a Jedi effort to [[Hunt for the Sith Emperor|capture]] the Sith Emperor, though the mission ultimately failed and the group was captured. When they were finally freed from the Emperor's clutches, Carsen and her allies [[Emperor's ritual crisis|raced to stop]] the Emperor's agents from bringing about [[Death/Legends|death]] on a galactic scale, and fought alongside her friends in a [[Dromund Kaas operation|mission]] that saw the Hero strike down the Sith Emperor on Dromund Kaas, turning the tide of the war.

Carsen continued to travel with the Hero in the years that followed, but when the Jedi Master disappeared around the time of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|invasion]] of the galaxy in [[3636 BBY]], it caused the Hero's group to fragment in the chaos. However, she eventually reunited with another member of the Hero's group&mdash;the former Sith Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]&mdash;and the two made it their mission to track down and eliminate their old enemy, the Sith Emperor, who had continued to escape the clutches of death. To that end, the pair struck down the Emperor's original body, and allied with the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in order to ensure that the threat of the Emperor was ended once and for all.

==Biography==
===Child of the Emperor===
{{Quote|My parents were Sith&mdash;but the Emperor isn't my father. "Child of the Emperor" is just a title. I was taken from my parents when I was a baby. Raised in the Sith Academy with others like Valis. It was&hellip; brutal.|Kira Carsen|<ref name="The Death Mark">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Death Mark|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
Kira Carsen was born to [[Human/Legends|Human]] parents on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[3663 BBY]].<ref name="Birth" /> [[Kira Carsen's mother|Both]] of her [[Kira Carsen's father|parents]] were [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and Carsen inherited her parents' [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], prompting the Empire to take her from them when she was extremely young as part of the [[Children of the Emperor]] project&mdash;a plot by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to create a host of puppet Force-users.<ref name="The Defector" />

Sent to the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Carsen underwent [[Sith training|training]] as a Sith alongside other young Force-users such as [[Valis]];<ref name="The Defector" /> she killed her first [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]], a hound native to Korriban, at age six.<ref name="A New Hobby">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Kira Carsen|A New Hobby}}</ref> During her time on Korriban, she encountered the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], to the point where the Sith was able to recognize Carsen when she was fully-grown over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later.<ref name="The Defector" />

However, during her time at the Academy, Carsen noticed that other children would disappear for unknown amounts of time. When they returned, they were different, unable to remember where they had been or sometimes who they or others were.<ref name="The Defector" /> In [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Birth" /> a ten-year-old<ref name="The Death Mark" /> Carsen discovered she could not recall [[Standard day/Legends|days]] or [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of time and realized that she too had been taken. The process had been completed, and she was now truly a Child of the Emperor, meaning that the Emperor could possess her mind and body at will.<ref name="The Defector" />

Fearful of what the Emperor could do to her,<ref name="The Defector" /> Carsen became determined to escape the Empire, and stowed away on a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] after it delivered a shipment of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to Korriban. She jumped ship when it stopped at the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where she spent the next eight years living in alleys and stealing to survive.<ref name="Escaping Korriban">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Kira Carsen|Escaping Korriban}}</ref> She joined a group of alien refugees in the [[High Security Lockdown]], where she met the [[Evocii]] [[Enaq]] and the [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Darshyn]].<ref name="The Merciful One">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Merciful One|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

Carsen spent her teenage years on Nar Shaddaa, using her nascent [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers to defend herself and her friends. She would often bundle up in extra clothes to make herself look bigger, and was fiercely protective of her friends. When a street gang called the [[Ur'kossags]] began terrorizing the refugees, Kira paid the gang a visit. However, her attempt to negotiate with them ended poorly, and Carsen ended up killing several gang members. Carsen's actions backfired, however, causing everyone in the area to fear the refugee group's reputation. Carsen did not understand what she had done, because she left the planet not long after.<ref name="The Merciful One" />

===Life as a Jedi===
[[File:Kira_Carsen.png|thumb|left|200px|Kira Carsen as a Jedi Padawan]]
Carsen's life changed when she attempted to steal a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engine from an expensive ship in the spaceport, of which she planned to disassemble and sell off the pieces. She did not realize, however, that the ship belonged to the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]], who was very surprised to catch Carsen in the middle of her planned theft. Master Kiwiiks quickly recognized Carsen's affinity for the Force and offered Carsen the opportunity to join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Escaping Korriban" />

During her time with Master Kiwiiks, the two visited the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Uphrades]], and Carsen was struck by how green the planet appeared from space.<ref name="Uphrades">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Uphrades|Uphrades}}</ref> The two had a very relaxed relationship, with Kiwiiks allowing Carsen a great deal of freedom as long as she was not in the Jedi Master's way.<ref name="Welcome">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Kira Carsen|Welcome: Ground Rules}}</ref>

Two years into her apprenticeship, in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date-1">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Carsen and Kiwiiks were on the Jedi [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] when the Jedi Order began encountering organized resistance from the native [[Flesh Raider]]s. During the conflict, Carsen met the [[Hero of Tython|Padawan]] of [[Orgus Din]].

[[File:Kira_Carsen_1.png|thumb|right|250px|Kira with her master Bela Kiwiiks]]
Carsen and Kiwiiks were then sent to the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They worked together to stop [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] from unleashing the [[Planet Prison]]. She chose to travel with her new partner, now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], and [[Satele Shan]] made her the Padawan of the Hero of Tython after Bela Kiwiiks left on a lone assignment to Tatooine. Carsen was later captured by agents of [[Darth Angral]] on the [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] space station. Angral, who had sworn a vendetta against Carsen's new Master, demanded to know where the Knight was. Carsen misled him into believing that her Master was on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. As Angral's retainers kept an eye on her, her new partner/master returned from the planet surface and freed her. Unfortunately, this allowed the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to find her at long last. He arranged for another Child, [[Valis]] to retrieve her. Carsen and her teacher were able to best Valis but Carsen was forced to come clean about her past, and decided to reveal the truth to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. Despite [[Jaric Kaedan]]'s attempt to have her imprisoned, the rest of the Council decided to show leniency.

Later, Carsen and her Master rescued Bela Kiwiiks on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and redeemed Lord [[Praven]]. She told her former Master everything about her past. Kiwiiks, an understanding Jedi, explained that she always had great faith in Carsen and her potential to become a Jedi.

====Free of the Emperor====
[[File:Kira_Possessed.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Carsen under the Emperor's control]]
Eventually things came to a head on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Darth Angral, driven insane by the death of his son, had attacked and planned to use the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] to destroy the entire planet, and the majority of the Jedi. Kira and her Master disabled the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] and confronted Angral. The Emperor possessed Carsen, and ordered Angral to kill the Knight. Soon after, Carsen regained her senses and felt the Emperor's hold over her. Angral encouraged her to join him, claiming it was her destiny to be Sith. Carsen stated that she'd "rather jump out of an airlock naked." When Angral failed, the Emperor stepped in, reasserting control over Carsen, and engaged the Knight. He had seen visions in which the Knight would rise and defeat him and he was determined to keep that from happening. When the Knight proved stronger, the Emperor called Carsen weak, unfinished from being away from him for so long. He then began to channel red Force energy through her in a renewed attempted to kill her Master, even if Carsen was to die in the process. Carsen refused to be his pawn and opened herself to the light, banishing the Emperor and severing the link. Returning to Tython's surface, Carsen was formally granted the rank of Jedi Knight by the Jedi Council.

[[File:Kira_Push_Back.png|thumb|right|200px|Carsen breaks free of the Emperor]]
Carsen eventually became part of a [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|Jedi strike team]], led by Master [[Tol Braga]], tasked with capturing the Emperor and redeeming him to the light side. Unfortunately, they underestimated the Emperor's power, which he used to subdue the Jedi and corrupt them to the dark side. Carsen was placed in an interrogation device called the Tormentor, about to be subjected to torture by her own Master. Luckily, her Master had been released from the Emperor's control with the assistance of the [[Force ghost/Legends|ghost]] of Orgus Din. After disposing of the Sith Overseer, Carsen and her Master made to free their companions, only to find the [[Emperor's Wrath]], Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], had already done so. Scourge stated that he had waited three hundred years for the appearance of Carsen's Master, whom he believed to be the one who would destroy the Emperor.

Returning to Tython, Scourge revealed to the Council the Emperor's plan to consume all life in the galaxy but he had foreseen that the Hero of Tython would rise to stop him. Carsen continued to travel with her Master as they went to Belsavis, [[Voss]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], well as redeem the fallen members of the Jedi strike team. Their efforts had weakened the Emperor enough that the Republic could make a strike on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] so the Hero of Tython could confront and defeat him. Carsen, along with the rest of the Hero's crew, excluding T7-01, kept their distance from the Emperor to avoid falling under his control while the Hero engaged him. Following the Emperor's apparent death, the Hero's crew rendezvoused with the flagship [[Valiant (Valor-class)|''Valiant'']], where they are awarded with the [[Cross of Glory]] for their actions.

Shortly afterwards, she and her master were given a holocall from a fellow Child of the Emperor, [[Suri]], who was driven mad from Vitiate's lingering calls to her. Since the two of them have previously broken free from the Emperor's control, Suri told them to meet her on [[Voss]]. When they arrived, Kira and the Hero of Tython tried to help her by convincing her to join them on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Then a group of Sith, other Children of the Emperor, arrived. Led by [[Tannac]], he told them that they managed to block out the Emperor and warned that if Suri went to Tython, she would die. After some deliberation with her master, Kira reluctantly allowed Suri to go with Tannac. She recorded the events and delivered it to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] later on, to show how the Children of the Emperor were still active.

====Later conflicts====
[[File:Kira_and_Scourge_Spar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kira and Scourge spar in front of the crew.]]
At a later stage in the Galactic War, Carsen was in the middle of a sparring session with Scourge, despite [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc's]] worry over using lightsabers. When their match came to an end, Carsen's Master suddenly had a vision of the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Coincidentally, T7 mentioned that Rishi had turned up on the ''Defender''{{'s}} [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], so the Hero set a course for the planet.

During the Eternal Empire's Conquest, Kira's master went missing. After the war was lost, the Defender's crew disbanded, much to Kira's sadness. Eventually, Kira joined the fight against Emperor [[Arcann]] alongside rebels against the [[Eternal Empire]]. According to Master [[Dazh Ranos|Ranos]], her group was eventually tracked down by Arcann and suffered heavy losses. Later, Kira and her team attempted to infiltrate Arcann's carbonite prison, but were discovered and thwarted by [[High Justice]] [[Vaylin]]. Despite Vaylin's great strength in the Force, Kira survived the encounter and, according to Darth [[Darth Hexid|Hexid]], was last seen disappearing into [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].

====Vitiate's legacy====
At some point Kira regrouped with Scourge, and, learning from an "old ally" of the ex-Emperor's Wrath, they hunted down Vitiate's true body (which was kept in stasis). The pair then managed to destroyed Vitiate's true body at the exact moment the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] purged Vitiate's spirit, ensuring that the galaxy's greatest evil would never return. However, in doing so, they unwittingly unleashed a powerful Sith ritual Vitiate carved into his body as a final failsafe. Having been infused with the Emperor's power in the past both she and Scourge were rendered comatose for just over a year until Satele Shan and her followers managed to save them. But Shan and her people also fell to the plague unleashed by Vitiate's body, prompting Carsen and Scourge to quarantine them aboard a large medical vessel they left drifting in the Outer Rim until help could be found<ref name="TLD">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|The Lingering Darkness|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>; Carsen initially desired to merely use a [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]]-sized ship, but Scourge insisted on it.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />

[[File:Kira_Carsen_on_Carrick_Station.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kira and Scourge approached Commander on Carrick Station.]]
Sensing the plague victims' minds were communicating and merging together, Carsen and Scourge suspected the plague might be trying to resurrect Vitiate. Concerned that Vitiate might've faked his death as he had done in the past, Scourge traveled to [[Mek-Sha]] and ambushed the Outlander, briefly engaging his opponent in battle before fleeing, confident that Vitiate was indeed dead. Following the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]], Carsen and Scourge made themselves known to the Outlander and later explained the threat of Vitiate's plague at the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]].<ref name="TLD" />

Now secure in having the one ally who ended the threat of the Emperor, Carsen sent a signal to the transport ship, but strangely received no response, and the uncertainty of the situation only made Scourge more anxious upon checking the next scheduled stop but found no trace. Upon return to Odessen, Scourge, having just regained his emotions after the Emperor's demise, tore up a meeting room in frustration. After informing the Commander of the situation, Carsen proposed sending out [[T7-O1]] with an escort and as many probe droids as possible to map out the few hundred potential star systems the transport could be in.<ref name="Pinnacles of Power">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Pinnacles of Power|Odessen}}</ref>

====Destroying Tenebrae====
{{Quote|The ritual carved into him isn't a plague. It's an imprint--an echo of who he was back then.|Kira Carsen, discovering the secret to Tenebrae's plague inside Satele's Mindscape|<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Echoes of Oblivion|Odessen}}</ref>}}
In the year [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref>, Kira Carsen and [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], with the aid of [[T7-O1]], were able to locate the [[Kira Carsen's ship|ship]] that they had placed Satele and her students aboard. Unfortunately, Teeseven's ship was attacked by an Imperial shuttle, which Scourge identified as belonging to the [[Servant]]s. With the aid of the Alliance Commander, they made their way aboard in order to stop [[Tenebrae]] from fully resurrecting himself. Getting onboard through the engineering deck, the party overheard [[Servant Fifteen]] and [[Servant Twenty-two]] speaking with [[Servant Four]] over holocomm, discussing acts of sabotage, which Carsen guessed was Teeseven's handiwork. Before they could wait for Servant Four to sign off, an impatient Scourge engaged them, forcing Carsen and the Commander to join in. After dispatching both Sith, Teeseven joined them, announcing that another group, later revealed to be the [[Scions of Zakuul]], were responsible for hijacking the ship. Carsen then split off with Teeseven to sabotage the main systems to keep anyone from getting off the ship and spreading Tenebrae's plague; Carsen would report her actions over comlink while making witty banter, annoying Scourge. <ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />

Once the party was certain the ship was secure, they rejoined in the medical bay, where the remaining Servants had gathered the comatose Jedi. They then engaged and killed Servant Four after she executed the Scion leader, [[Minazar]]. Afterwards, Carsen checked on Satele and her students and was saddened to discover that [[Tral]] and [[Syl]] were deceased. With no time to waste, Carsen then led her allies in a ritual that allowed them to enter [[Mindscape|Satele Shan's mind]].<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />

[[File:Kira_Carsen_in_Echoes_of_Oblivion.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Kira Carsen inside Satele Shan's mind]]
Once inside, Carsen found herself alone with the Alliance Commander, having been separated from Scourge and the rest. Pushing onwards, they encountered three visages of the Emperor, as Valkorion, Vitiate and a black-eyed Sith the Commander identified as Tenebrae, who taunted them for believing they could ever try to defeat him. Carsen then realized the plague was actually an imprint of Tenebrae himself. Soon after, Carsen was separated from the Commander, who continued their journey to the center of Satele Shan's mind, aided by the spirits of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Meetra Surik]], and [[Darth Marr]]. Once at the center, Carsen met up with the Commander and helped fight against the Emperor, alongside the spirits of all those that had been victimized by him over the centuries; Carsen stood for all the people Tenebrae had manipulated. After a long-fought battle, they were successfully able to vanquish the Sith Emperor once and for all.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />

====Temple of Nul====
Later that year, Carsen accompanied the Alliance Commander, along with [[Sana-Rae]], to the planet of [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]. While in hyperspace, Carsen confessed that when the Commander returned from Elom, both she and Scourge got a strange feeling, like they had uncovered a hazy memory This was in an attempt to uncover what [[Darth Malgus]] had done at the [[Temple of Nul]] shortly before being captured. After touching an artifact from the temple, Carsen believed that she had uncovered that Nul had once been a [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]]. As [[Tau Idair]] questioned Malgus' interest in a long deceased Child of the Emperor, Master [[Gnost-Dural]] suggested that [[Sa'har Kateen]], a Padawan attached to Master [[Denolm Orr]]'s expedition team, might be able to tell them, given that she was unaccounted for. While they search for any leads on Sa'har's whereabouts, Gnost-Dural suggested the Commander question Malgus, who remained confident in his own plans succeeding despite his capture, though Carsen remained skeptical he would divulge anything.<ref name="Digging Deeper">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

Carsen later returned to Odessen after the Commander had finished questioning Malgus and learned that their initial assumption about Nul was wrong, as she was in fact the creator of the Children of the Emperor, a revelation that unsettled her. Upon hearing that Malgus claimed that his plan would succeed that Nul's secrets wouldn't stay buried forever, Carsen dismissed it as a bluff, insisting that she and Scourge had spent years hunting down the old Emperor's followers and hadn't found a trace about Nul, leading her to believe the Emperor executed Nul and destroyed all her creations for good measure. However, Lana Beniko then played a recording from Denolm Orr, whom confessed he was a former Child of the Emperor like Carsen. Carsen also noted from the recording of Orr mentioning a [[Darth Nul's holocron|holocron]] that was also unaccounted for. As much as she wanted to believe the missing Padawan and the missing holocron were related, she admitted she stopped believing coincidences a long time ago.<ref name="Digging Deeper" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I still remember that little girl, bundling up in extra layers of clothing. Trying to look bigger and tougher than she was.''"<br />"''Hey, it worked. Add enough layers, and nobody knows who you are.'' [&hellip;] ''Life was hard and then I became a Jedi. But I never forgot my friends.|Enaq and Carsen|<ref name="The Merciful One" />}}
[[File:Kira_Carsen_2.png|thumb|right|200px|Kira Carsen]]
Kira has fair skin, red hair, full lips, and a scar on her left cheek.

Kira Carsen was a headstrong and confident Jedi, with a strong sense of loyalty towards her friends and allies. She was described as worldly, kind-hearted and reckless. Behind this confident front, she hid fear of her past and a near-desperate desire to prove herself. She believed that her past in the Sith Empire would cause those she knew to turn on her if they ever found out, so Kira was determined to prove her loyalty and worth to the Jedi Order.<ref name="The Defector" /> She was also mildly claustrophobic, and she masked fear behind a quick tongue and sharp wit.

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Before we go&hellip; you need to know something, and I'd rather let you hear it from ''me.'' I never told you about my childhood. I'm not what you ''think'' I am&hellip;''"<br />"''So much about you is now ''clear'' to me, Kira. But you're wrong about one thing. You are exactly who I think&mdash;a ''strong,'' capable young woman. One day, you'll be a great Jedi.|Carsen and Bela Kiwiiks|<ref name="The Sand Demon">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Sand Demon|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
Kira Carsen was adept with a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] and a closed-combat duelist, usually wearing light armor.<ref name="Date-1" /> <ref name="Holonet" /> Her combat skills allowed her to deal a large amount of damage over a short period of time. Kira was considerably strong in the Force, being able to break free of the Emperor's control over her during the Desolator Crisis.

==Behind the scenes==
Kira Carsen appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] character. The player gains her as a companion during the class storyline on Coruscant. Kira is voiced by [[Laura Bailey]].

===Romance===
If the Jedi Knight player character is male, the player can choose to have a romance with Kira and can eventually marry her. Initiating a romance will affect dialogue in certain story missions. If the player is romancing Kira, then she will speak to the player about the future, children as one of the last topics. If the player is married to Kira, then a cutscene of her speaking to the player at the Emperor's temple won't be seen.

Following the conclusion of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion, the player can re-commit their romance with Kira. Additionally, if the player is a female Jedi Knight who initially flirts with Kira, she later expresses that she has always been "a little... in love" with the player since their disappearance. The player can reciprocate those feeling and initiate a relationship with Kira.
